D5/S3/Geometry/BooleanRotationCodebook.f.name: D5.S3.Geometry.BooleanRotationCodebook.finite_codebook_lower_bound
D5/S3/Geometry/BooleanRotationCodebook.f.signature: theorem finite_codebook_lower_bound (n : ℕ) {L ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hL : 3 * ε < L) (C : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)) (hC : Adequate n L ε C) : (n.factorial : ℝ) * L ^ n ≤ (C.card : ℝ) * (2 * n).choose n * ε ^ n

D5/S3/Geometry/BooleanRotationCodebook.f.name: D5.S3.Geometry.BooleanRotationCodebook.finite_codebook_upper_bound
D5/S3/Geometry/BooleanRotationCodebook.f.signature: theorem finite_codebook_upper_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ C : Finset (Fin n → ℝ), Adequate n L ε C ∧ C.card ≤ (⌈L * n / (2 * ε)⌉₊) ^ n ∧ (L = 2 * Real.pi → FixedDecoderAdequate n ε C)
